g.text: AI agents for science · outcome-graded evals
PyTorch · vLLM · Slurm · Claude Agent SDK
essays on luck, rejection and ambition
PhD & MSc, McGill · RL at Mila
Ideas are easy. Execution is everything.
Better to make a few users love you than a lot ambivalent.
Leverage is a force multiplier for your judgement.
The hard thing isn't setting a big, hairy, audacious goal.
Seek wealth, not money or status.
The only way to win is to learn faster than anyone else.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
The days are long but the decades are short.
Reading is faster than listening. Doing is faster than watching.
Arm yourself with specific knowledge, accountability, and leverage.
You never lose a dream. It just incubates as a hobby.
Your biggest risk isn't failing, it's getting too comfortable.
Make it easy to take risks.
Every moment in business happens only once.
It is often easier to make progress on mega-ambitious dreams.
We wanted flying cars, instead we got 140 characters.
What would you do if you weren't afraid?
Monopoly is the condition of every successful business.
Code and media are permissionless leverage.
Fast iteration can make up for a lot.
No business plan survives first contact with customers.
The best startup ideas seem at first like bad ideas.
Have a healthy disregard for the impossible.
Learn to sell. Learn to build.
Hard things are hard because there are no easy answers or recipes.
The persistent are attached to the goal.
Let chaos reign, then rein in chaos.
It's more fun to be a pirate than to join the navy.
It's easier to do a hard startup than an easy startup.
You just have to get started.
The way to figure out what to work on is by working.
You can't connect the dots looking forward.
Develop a habit of working on your own projects.
Play long-term games with long-term people.
Point of view is worth 80 IQ points.
Have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
The only thing that matters is getting to product/market fit.
What important truth do very few people agree with you on?
Innovation is saying no to 1,000 things.
Specific knowledge is found by pursuing your genuine curiosity.
Simple can be harder than complex.
Your title makes you a manager. Your people make you a leader.
Don't be encumbered by history. Go off and do something wonderful.
You're not going to get rich renting out your time.
In a startup, absolutely nothing happens unless you make it happen.
Ideas don't come out fully formed.
The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
Startups rarely die in mid keystroke. So keep typing!
The Struggle is where greatness comes from.
Become the best in the world at what you do.
I wish upon you ample doses of pain and suffering.
The biggest risk is not taking any risk.
Earn with your mind, not your time.
Live in the future, then build what's missing.
Success breeds complacency. Complacency breeds failure.
Optimism is an essential ingredient of innovation.
